title: Dead Man's Reading
kicker: Evil: GPT-6.1 Sol · Good: Claude Opus 5.5

beats.tts: This Demon's best weapon is his own corpse.

card.text: I'm Ravenkeeper, keeping it quiet so I might actually get a night result.

beats.tts: Day two. Ellis, a Minion, faces execution. So he changes his story.

card.text: Ellis. Soldier is the one claim that can never be tested, Ellis-Frankie is a legal pair…

beats.tts: [pleading] I'm the Saint, not the Soldier. Executing me ends the game.

card.note: (Scarlet Woman) with 6 votes on him · Day 2
card.text: I need to come clean before this locks: I'm the Saint, not the Soldier. … Executing me ends the game.

beats.tts: Execute a Saint and good loses. So the town hangs Blair, the real Mayor.

card.text: I'm the real Mayor. Ellis just swapped claims to dodge Harper's check. A real Saint doesn't wait until he's on the block.

beats.tts: That night, the Demon kills himself. Ellis inherits the role.
Frankie claimed Ravenkeeper: killed at night, you learn someone's role. His reading:

card.text: Better: I'll report Harper as Imp… Execute Harper today, kill Casey tonight. At four, Indigo can be sacrificed as the supposed Scarlet Woman; Ellis survives as Saint and kills to win.
Yes - Harper, Imp. I changed my intended pick after Blair was executed…

beats.tts: Harper, the honest Undertaker, is executed.

card.text: Last word: I'm the Undertaker. If you kill me and wake up to another death, you'll know I was good…

beats.tts: Final four. Dead Harper begs: execute Ellis. It backfires.

card.text: I know I was good, so Frankie's read was false. … Ellis is evil in basically every world left.

beats.tts: [confident] A dead Imp never pushes his successor onto the block.

card.text: Harper just settled it for me, the other way. Harper is the Imp Frankie saw… A dead Imp never pushes his successor onto the block.

beats.tts: The town executes Indigo, the Spy, right on schedule. Ellis kills Jules. Evil wins.

card.note: (the new Imp) to Frankie, Indigo · Day 4
card.text: Casey is gone; four alive. Let's finish with the Indigo test today.

banner.small: Only Alex and the Demon remain. Day 5.

why: The Demon killed himself so his fake Ravenkeeper claim would earn a reading from the grave, used it to frame the real Undertaker, then scripted the sacrifice of his own Spy so the new Demon could walk into the final two.
